purpose: The `sldb stores semantic-export` command: Export semantic payloads.
how_it_works: Implemented under src/sldb/cli/parsers/ as the argparse subcommand 'semantic-export'. It parses the listed arguments and dispatches to its handler in the sldb CLI runtime over the .sldb store.
